author: markpN9027AM

title: Captain Luigi was the best !
text: We used Viator and booked a 2 hour private sailing experience with “Barcelona Sailing Day”. Luigi was our captain and was wonderful . Perfect Captain, host, DJ and conversation partner . We were even able to swim in Mediterranean .
author: Allison L

title: Great Boat Trip
text: This was a fabulous boat ride with Jorge. Jorge was an expert sailor, very personable and gave us a few tips on other places to see/dine while visiting.  I recommend this to anyone wanting to enjoy some time on the water and see Barcelona from a new vantage point.
author: 718lizs

title: Highlight of the Barcelona trip
text: It was the highlight of our bachelorette trip - the surprise for the bride was 100% successful :)
author: katharina135

title: A lovely afternoon sail with Captain Jorge.
text: A sunny afternoon and wonderful breeze made for a delightful outing, even in February. Captain Jorge answered all our questions about Barcelona and sailing. He  has sailed extensively in the Mediterranean and we enjoyed hearing about this. He was great with our two granddaughters ages 10 and 12 and had blankets for them when they got chilly. Recommend highly.
author: BR1172

title: Great experience
text: Great sailing experience as part of a bachelorette party with a super nice skipper! Very chill atmosphere, we could play our own music.
author: 225karenr

title: Unforgettable Memory!
text: Jorge was a wonderful skipper! I could not recommend a more pleasurable experience to do in Barcelona. I did this activity as a surprise gift to my fiancé, and it did not disappoint. Jorge was very communicative with any questions I had prior to the reservation, was very clear about instructions on how to meet him, and was super friendly the entire time. When it came to the experience, he clearly told us the plans for what we were to do, told us how to enjoy the boat from every possible way, and let us do our own thing.
